title: ASMR whispered deep ocean science for deep sleep · drift off tonight (2 hr)
description:
A slow, whispered trip down through the dark ocean: why deep animals glow, why so many are red or clear, how they live under the weight of the sea, and what happens when a whale comes to rest on the sea floor.
The voice is AI: a clone of the creator's own whisper, made with Chatterbox. The facts come from checked public sources.
2 hr of soft whispering over dim, slow footage of the real thing, no music.

Written for sleep from fact-checked How We Know scripts (howweknowdeep.com).

Picture credits
Melanocetus murrayi, Challenger Report plate (1887): Robert Mintern, in A. Günther, Report on the Deep-Sea Fishes of H.M.S. Challenger (1887) (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Melanocetus_murrayi_(Murrays_abyssal_anglerfish).jpg)
